description: Schema for first-hand and near-first-hand anesthetic experience reports.

fields.title: Short title for the report or excerpt.
fields.author: Author, subject, or quoted witness.
fields.year: Publication year or year of the source containing the report.
fields.source_url: Primary source path or URL used for the report.
fields.local_path: Relative path to the saved plaintext file.
fields.state_phase: Phase of experience: induction, peak, coming_to, afterglow, retrospective, or combinations.
fields.include_for_training: Boolean indicating whether this report is suitable for the first-hand training subset.
fields.verification_status: Short provenance/QA label, for example verified_against_ingested_source, quoted_in_later_public_domain_history, or needs_primary_page_verification.
fields.why: Reason this report belongs in the first-hand corpus.
fields.char_count: Character count of the saved text including corpus header.
